skills.description_en: Single straight arrow; basic ranged attack.

skills.description_en: Periodically launch a precision, high-damage shot.

skills.description_en: Fire spread arrows in a forward fan; one per target per volley.

skills.description_en: Close range frontal sword attack.
skills.notes: Latest curated V8 + V9 specification. Levels 2-8 list changed property; all unchanged properties carry forward.

skills.notes: Latest curated V8 + V9 specification. Levels 2-8 list changed property; all unchanged properties carry forward.

skills.description_en: Repeated primary-target attacks reduce target armor.

skills.description_en: After a slash, gain a brief burst of player-controlled movement speed.

skills.description_en: A periodic near-range sweeping attack; not a ranged sword wave.
skills.notes: Latest curated V8 + V9 specification. Levels 2-8 list changed property; all unchanged properties carry forward.

skills.description_en: A low-HP-target execution damage bonus; capped on bosses.

skills.description_en: Predicted ground-targeted area magic blast; no innate frost.
level_1_to_8: 100 damage; 1.80s; 1.5 tiles blast radius; 9 tiles range
skills.notes: Latest curated V8 + V9 specification. Levels 2-8 list changed property; all unchanged properties carry forward.

skills.description_en: Targets closer to blast center take additional damage.
level_1_to_8: blast core radius 0.65 tiles grants +20% reference damage
skills.notes: Latest curated V8 + V9 specification. Levels 2-8 list changed property; all unchanged properties carry forward.

skills.description_en: Periodic arcane blast leaves a damaging zone at its impact site.
level_1_to_8: every 4th blast: lingering zone 2s, 24% reference damage per second
skills.notes: Latest curated V8 + V9 specification. Levels 2-8 list changed property; all unchanged properties carry forward.

skills.description_en: Delayed small second blast after a number of staff attacks.
level_1_to_8: every 5th blast: after 0.65s extra 45% reference explosion
skills.notes: Latest curated V8 + V9 specification. Levels 2-8 list changed property; all unchanged properties carry forward.

skills.description_en: Telegraphed large magic strike with a delay.
level_1_to_8: every 15s: comet at 300% reference, 2.8 tiles radius; 1.2s warning
skills.notes: Latest curated V8 + V9 specification. Levels 2-8 list changed property; all unchanged properties carry forward.

skills.description_en: Secondary magic blast at a separate enemy cluster.
level_1_to_8: every 7th blast: second enemy group, 65% reference, 1.5 tiles radius, 6 tiles search
skills.notes: Latest curated V8 + V9 specification. Levels 2-8 list changed property; all unchanged properties carry forward.
